scope.research_boundary: Use one read-only evidence reviewer; root remains the sole writer. Audit each exact target's image record, latest attempt, 50-approach history, and sources added after that attempt. A new web query and at most one new page open per target are allowed only when a genuinely new exact-model image or rights lead exists; literal-search each proposed URL in data/ and docs/ before opening it. Use manufacturer or exact authorized-seller pages only; do not access XHS, social/community posts, personal profiles, CAPTCHA, or login routes in this batch. Return exact URL, actual access date, exact subject match, owner/credit, supported rights basis, and unresolved caveats. Do not edit files, download or copy image assets, or infer a product alias/build from appearance alone.
excluded: No changes to image records or catalog facts without root integration after the frozen review.
No image downloads, local copies, generated product depictions, or unsupported reuse claims.
No new campaign extensions for other fields or any of the 69 open specification/price fields.
No GitHub mutation, commit, push, PR, merge, publish or production write.
